definition: מָנֶה noun masculine maneh, mina , a weight (perhaps originally a specific part ; Late Hebrew id. ; Assyrian manû Dl HWB 417 ; Aramaic , מַנְיָא ); — ׳ מ Ezek 45:12 מָנִים 1Kgs 10:17 + 3 t.; = 50 shekels Ezek 45:12 (on חֲמִשִּׁים for חֲמִשָּׁה see Hi Co ); of gold 1Kgs 10:17 of silver Ezra 2:69 ; Neh 7:71 ; Neh 7:72 . — The weight of the mina was 1/60 of talent; i.e. according to older (Babylonian) standard, 982.2 grammes (= 60 shekels at approximately 16.37 g.) = approximately 2 lbs.; in Ezekiel's time the mina = 50 shekels = 818.6 g. = approximately 1 2/3 lb. (compare כִּכָּר , שֶׁקֶל ). See J. Benz Archaeology 187 ff. 194 Now Archaeology i. 208 f .
